paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tu in Pharaoh kiang a bang ahia ka hih ding na mu ding. Khut thahat in amau apaisak dia, khut thahat in amau agam a kipan hawlkhe ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”

paite: Pathian in Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, akiang ah, "Kei TOUPA ka hi.
heading: Pathian In Mosi Asam
english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.

paite: Bangkim hihthei Pathian min in Abraham kiang, Isak kiang leh Jakob kiang ah ka kilakta a, himahleh ka min JEHOVAH in alak uah ka kitheisak kei.
english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.

paite: Amau Kanaan gam, mikhual a a-omna gam uh, akhualzinna gam uh, pe ding in amaute toh ka thukhun leng ka hihkipta hi.
english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

paite: Aiguptate'n koltanna a, atansak un, Israel suante maunate leng ka zata a, ka thukhun ka theigige hi.
english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, kei TOUPA ka hi, chih gen inla, Aiguptate puakgik nuai a pan ka hon pikhe dia, na koltanna ua pan ka hon suaktasak ding, ban zak in leh vaihawmna thupite toh ka hon tan ding hi.
english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

paite: Mipite a ding in ka hong kilak ding a, noute a ding in Pathian ka hi ding. Huchi in Aiguptate puakgikte nuai a pan hon lakhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

paite: Gam tungtang thu Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a pe dia ka chiamsa, huai gamsung ah ka hon tun ding. Huchi in gouluah ding in ka hon pe ding, Kei TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
english: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah huchibang in thu agensawn hi. Himahleh lungsim dahna ziak leh koltanna haksatna ziak in Mosi angaikheta kei uh.
english: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Lut in, agam a pan Israel suante apaikhiaksakna ding in Pharaoh kiang ah thu gen in,” achi hi.
english: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, Israel suante'n hon ngaihkhiak kei ualeh kei muk sum louh, bangchi in Pharaoh in hon ngaikhe dia?" achi hi.
english: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante pikhe ding in Israel suante lam leh Aigupta kumpipa lam ah amaute thu apeta hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Hiaite asuangtute inkuan a kipan alupente ahi uhi: Israel ta masa Reuben tate; Hanok leh Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi, hiaite Reuben inkote ahi uh.
heading: Mosi Leh Aaron Inkuante Chiamtehna
english: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

paite: Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Kanaan numei tapa Shaul. Hiaite Simeon inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

paite: Akhang uh dungzui in hiaite Levi tapate min ahi: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. Levi damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

paite: Gershon tapate, a-inkuan dungzui un, Libni leh Shimei.
english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

paite: Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel. Kohath damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-thum ahi.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.

paite: Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi. Akhang uh dungzui in hiaite Levi inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

paite: Amram in apa sanggamnu Jokebed zi in anei hi. Ama'n Aaron leh Mosi aneihsak hi. Amram damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi.
english: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

paite: Izhar tapate: Korah, Nepheg leh Zikri.
english: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

paite: Uzziel tapate: Mishael, Elzaphan leh Zithri.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

paite: Aaron in Amminadab tanu, Nahson sanggamnu, Elisheba zi in anei a, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar aneihsak hi.
english: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

paite: Korah tapate: Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph. Hiaite Korah inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

paite: Aaron tapa Eleazar in Putiel tanute lak a khat zi in anei a, Phinehas aneihsak hi. Hiaite Levi inkuan suangtute inn a kipan a lupente ahi uhi.
english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

paite: Hiaite TOUPA'N Aaron leh Mosi kiang a anam uh dungzui a Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante hon pikhia un, achihte ahi.
english: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

paite: Hiaite Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh kiang a Aigupta a pan Israel suante pikhe dia thugentute ahi ua, hiaite Mosi leh Aaron mah ahi uhi.
english: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N thu agen ni in akiang ah,
heading: Mosi Leh Aaron Kiang A Pathian Thupiak
english: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

paite: "Kei TOUPA ka hi. Na kiang a ka gen tengteng Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”

paite: Himahleh Mosi in TOUPA ma ah, “Ngai in, muk sum louh ka hi a, bangchi in Pharaoh in hon ngaikhe dia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
